title: Smart Pipe | Infomercials | Adult Swim
summary: An Adult Swim infomercial parody for Smart Pipe, a fictional startup that turns toilet waste into data and social connectivity. It satirizes everything-connected tech culture.
why: HN posts it as a joke whenever a real smart toilet, IoT gadget or silly startup idea appears, because reality keeps matching the parody.

quote.text: Adult Swim did a critical parody two years ago which still nails the hidden motives of many startups.
